about.name: Coach Shamon Bell
about.title: DC
about.bio:
Coach Shamon Bell is a proven 23 specialist with 3 years of coaching experience at Arkansas Christian (8 Man). Known for a disciplined, film-first approach, Coach Bell develops intelligent, technically sound players who make an impact on every down.

If you're looking to elevate your game on the defensive side of the ball and compete at the next level, Coach Bell's coaching is where that journey starts.
